subject.title: fix(agents): treat codex exec_command as exec-like

question: Should this PR require live Codex app-server proof before merge, or may source-contract inspection plus focused OpenClaw tests be accepted for this `exec_command` warning fix?
rationale: The code direction looks sound, but the exact producer path is still not live-proven and current OpenClaw projection maps `commandExecution` to `bash`, so accepting proof short of a real run needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Require live proof before merge
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a recording that demonstrates both read-only suppression and mutating warning behavior after the patch.

options.title: Accept source-contract proof
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly override the proof gate if the Codex source contract plus focused OpenClaw tests are enough for this bugfix.

options.title: Pause until producer evidence exists
options.body: Keep or close the branch as not merge-ready until a live or producer-path trace shows raw `exec_command` reaches the affected warning path.

recommendation.title: Require live proof before merge
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a recording that demonstrates both read-only suppression and mutating warning behavior after the patch.
